description: Source code for validating the 'feat' table in TrueTypeGX/AAT font tables, part of the FreeType project. Contains functions for validating feature entries, registry, and related data structures.

methods.name: gxv_feat_registry_validate
methods.description: Validates feature registry entries, checking range, existence, and flags.

methods.name: gxv_feat_name_index_validate
methods.description: Validates the name index of a feature.

methods.name: gxv_feat_setting_validate
methods.description: Validates individual feature settings, including range and exclusivity.

methods.name: gxv_feat_name_validate
methods.description: Validates the entire feature name entry, including feature number, settings, and flags.

methods.name: gxv_feat_validate
methods.description: Main function to validate the entire 'feat' table in a font.
